candidateSources.title: Fare Capping - City of Santa Clarita Transit
candidateSources.evidenceExcerpt: Skip to content Search for: Search Skip to content Fares & Passes Routes & Schedules Services News & Events Resources About Us Home Fare Capping Fare Capping What Is Fare Capping? Fare capping is a new way to pay your fare that ensures you never overpay — you simply pay per ride, and once you’ve spent up to a set “cap” amount for the day or week, any additional rides are FREE! Instead of buying local daily or monthly passes in advance, you use Stored Value on your TAP card or TAP app, or purchase Single Ride Passes on the Token Transit app, and your rides accumulate toward a 1-Day cap and a 7-Day cap. Once you hit one of those limits, you ride free for the rest of that period! This makes fare payment easy, as there is no upfront cost for a pass, and frequent riders can benefit the most!
